mapper.select:
SELECT id, supplier_name, order_date, arrival_date, payment_method, payment_term, payment_term_code, payment_due_date, amount, remark, status, paid_date, created_at, updated_at FROM supplier_payment_pending
ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = N'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN payment_due_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, payment_due_date ASC, order_date DESC, id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

where.if: AND status = N'open' AND payment_due_date IS NOT NULL AND payment_due_date < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
AND status = N'open' AND payment_due_date IS NOT NULL AND payment_due_date >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND payment_due_date <= DATEADD(day, 7, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
AND status = N'open' AND payment_due_date IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT id, supplier_name, order_date, arrival_date, payment_method, payment_term, payment_term_code, payment_due_date, amount, remark, status, paid_date, created_at, updated_at FROM supplier_payment_pending WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier_payment_pending ( supplier_name, order_date, arrival_date, payment_method, payment_term, payment_term_code, payment_due_date, amount, remark, status, paid_date ) VALUES ( #{supplierName}, #{orderDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{arrivalDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentTerm}, #{paymentTermCode}, #{paymentDueDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{amount, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{paidDate, jdbcType=DATE} )
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payment_pending SET supplier_name = #{supplierName}, order_date = #{orderDate, jdbcType=DATE}, arrival_date = #{arrivalDate, jdbcType=DATE}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, payment_term = #{paymentTerm}, payment_term_code = #{paymentTermCode}, payment_due_date = #{paymentDueDate, jdbcType=DATE}, amount = #{amount, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, paid_date = #{paidDate, jdbcType=DATE}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
